verbatim_quote.original: The cap must apply BEFORE the prompt string is built, and the same capped text must be what is sent (the cache key may keep hashing the raw file bytes).
verbatim_quote.english_translation: The cap must apply BEFORE the prompt string is built, and the same capped text must be what is sent (the cache key may keep hashing the raw file bytes).

extracted_decision.summary: Apply the transcript cap before prompt construction; send the capped text; allow the cache key to keep hashing raw file bytes.
extracted_decision.rationale: Ensures the request is bounded and the model receives the capped text while preserving existing cache-key behavior.
alternatives: Change cache key to hash capped text
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Cache key can diverge from prompt content if the cap changes, though the env value is process-constant
